answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 20152 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: My question is as: zakat is farz on the cost of property (I mean extra house,shops,land etc)or not. If the house is on rent then zakat will be due on rent and cost both. pl clarify. Question: Assalamoalaikum,My question is as: zakat is farz on the cost of property (I mean extra house,shops,land etc)or not. If the house is on rent then zakat will be due on rent and cost both. pl clarify. Answer ID: 20152 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 378/258/L=1431) (1) If any thing from above-mentioned articles is not bought with the intention of business then there is no zakah on their value. (2) In case the house is on rent, zakah shall be wajib on its rent if other conditions of zakah are also fulfilled. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
